sec.title: September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 704)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across early rapid-fire Bob Hope variety comedy featuring guest jazz vocalist Mel Tormé for Pepsodent, classic teenage domestic misadventures on *The Aldrich Family* (Ezra Stone in 1939 and Norman Tokar in 1942), high-energy AFRS *Jubilee* broadcasts with Ernie Whitman spotlighting The Treniers and New Orleans jazz pioneer Kid Ory, and offbeat network studio satire with Bob and Ray, Bob Hope (1936), *The Aldrich Family* (1939, 1942), *Jubilee* (1948, 1949), and *Bob and Ray* (1936–1952):
